sections.title: Example 1: Regression Metrics
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 1: Regression Metrics")
print("-" * 50)

# Generate regression data
X_reg, y_reg = make_regression(n_samples=1000, n_features=5, noise=20, random_state=42)
X_train_reg, X_test_reg, y_train_reg, y_test_reg = train_test_split(
    X_reg, y_reg, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Train models
models_reg = {
    "Linear Regression": LinearRegression(),
    "Random Forest": RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, random_state=42),
}

results_reg = {}
for name, model in models_reg.items():
    model.fit(X_train_reg, y_train_reg)
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test_reg)

    # Calculate metrics
    mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test_reg, y_pred)
    mse = mean_squared_error(y_test_reg, y_pred)
    rmse = np.sqrt(mse)
    r2 = r2_score(y_test_reg, y_pred)

    # Calculate adjusted R-squared
    n = len(y_test_reg)
    p = X_test_reg.shape[1]
    adj_r2 = 1 - (1 - r2) * (n - 1) / (n - p - 1)

    # Calculate MAPE
    mape = np.mean(np.abs((y_test_reg - y_pred) / y_test_reg)) * 100

    results_reg[name] = {
        "MAE": mae,
        "MSE": mse,
        "RMSE": rmse,
        "R²": r2,
        "Adjusted R²": adj_r2,
        "MAPE": mape,
    }

    print(f"\n{name}:")
    print(f"  MAE: {mae:.4f}")
    print(f"  MSE: {mse:.4f}")
    print(f"  RMSE: {rmse:.4f}")
    print(f"  R²: {r2:.4f}")
    print(f"  Adjusted R²: {adj_r2:.4f}")
    print(f"  MAPE: {mape:.2f}%")

# Visualize regression results
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(15, 12))

# Actual vs Predicted plots
for i, (name, model) in enumerate(models_reg.items()):
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test_reg)

    axes[0, i].scatter(y_test_reg, y_pred, alpha=0.6)
    axes[0, i].plot(
        [y_test_reg.min(), y_test_reg.max()],
        [y_test_reg.min(), y_test_reg.max()],
        "r--",
        lw=2,
    )
    axes[0, i].set_xlabel("Actual Values")
    axes[0, i].set_ylabel("Predicted Values")
    axes[0, i].set_title(f"{name} - Actual vs Predicted")
    axes[0, i].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Residual plots
for i, (name, model) in enumerate(models_reg.items()):
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test_reg)
    residuals = y_test_reg - y_pred

    axes[1, i].scatter(y_pred, residuals, alpha=0.6)
    axes[1, i].axhline(y=0, color="r", linestyle="--")
    axes[1, i].set_xlabel("Predicted Values")
    axes[1, i].set_ylabel("Residuals")
    axes[1, i].set_title(f"{name} - Residual Plot")
    axes[1, i].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

sections.title: Example 2: Classification Metrics
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 2: Classification Metrics")
print("-" * 50)

# Generate classification data
X_clf, y_clf = make_classification(
    n_samples=1000,
    n_features=10,
    n_informative=8,
    n_redundant=2,
    n_classes=2,
    random_state=42,
)
X_train_clf, X_test_clf, y_train_clf, y_test_clf = train_test_split(
    X_clf, y_clf, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_clf
)

# Train models
models_clf = {
    "Logistic Regression": LogisticRegression(random_state=42, max_iter=1000),
    "Random Forest": RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42),
}

results_clf = {}
for name, model in models_clf.items():
    model.fit(X_train_clf, y_train_clf)
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test_clf)
    y_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test_clf)[:, 1]

    # Calculate metrics
    accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test_clf, y_pred)
    precision = precision_score(y_test_clf, y_pred)
    recall = recall_score(y_test_clf, y_pred)
    f1 = f1_score(y_test_clf, y_pred)
    roc_auc = roc_auc_score(y_test_clf, y_pred_proba)
    logloss = log_loss(y_test_clf, y_pred_proba)
    kappa = cohen_kappa_score(y_test_clf, y_pred)
    mcc = matthews_corrcoef(y_test_clf, y_pred)

    results_clf[name] = {
        "Accuracy": accuracy,
        "Precision": precision,
        "Recall": recall,
        "F1-Score": f1,
        "ROC-AUC": roc_auc,
        "Log Loss": logloss,
        "Cohen's Kappa": kappa,
        "MCC": mcc,
    }

    print(f"\n{name}:")
    print(f"  Accuracy: {accuracy:.4f}")
    print(f"  Precision: {precision:.4f}")
    print(f"  Recall: {recall:.4f}")
    print(f"  F1-Score: {f1:.4f}")
    print(f"  ROC-AUC: {roc_auc:.4f}")
    print(f"  Log Loss: {logloss:.4f}")
    print(f"  Cohen's Kappa: {kappa:.4f}")
    print(f"  MCC: {mcc:.4f}")

# Visualize classification results
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# Confusion matrices
for i, (name, model) in enumerate(models_clf.items()):
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test_clf)
    cm = confusion_matrix(y_test_clf, y_pred)

    sns.heatmap(cm, annot=True, fmt="d", cmap="Blues", ax=axes[0, i])
    axes[0, i].set_title(f"{name} - Confusion Matrix")
    axes[0, i].set_xlabel("Predicted")
    axes[0, i].set_ylabel("Actual")

# ROC curves
for i, (name, model) in enumerate(models_clf.items()):
    y_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test_clf)[:, 1]
    fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_test_clf, y_pred_proba)
    roc_auc = roc_auc_score(y_test_clf, y_pred_proba)

    axes[1, i].plot(fpr, tpr, label=f"{name} (AUC = {roc_auc:.3f})")
    axes[1, i].plot([0, 1], [0, 1], "k--", label="Random")
    axes[1, i].set_xlabel("False Positive Rate")
    axes[1, i].set_ylabel("True Positive Rate")
    axes[1, i].set_title(f"{name} - ROC Curve")
    axes[1, i].legend()
    axes[1, i].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

print("\nExample 3: Precision-Recall Curves")
print("-" * 50)

# Create imbalanced dataset
X_imb, y_imb = make_classification(
    n_samples=1000,
    n_features=10,
    n_informative=8,
    n_redundant=2,
    n_classes=2,
    weights=[0.9, 0.1],
    random_state=42,
)
X_train_imb, X_test_imb, y_train_imb, y_test_imb = train_test_split(
    X_imb, y_imb, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_imb
)

# Train model on imbalanced data
rf_imb = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)
rf_imb.fit(X_train_imb, y_train_imb)
y_pred_proba_imb = rf_imb.predict_proba(X_test_imb)[:, 1]

# Calculate precision-recall curve
precision, recall, thresholds = precision_recall_curve(y_test_imb, y_pred_proba_imb)

# Plot precision-recall curve

plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)

plt.xlabel("Recall")
plt.ylabel("Precision")
plt.title("Precision-Recall Curve (Imbalanced Data)")
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Compare with ROC curve
fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_test_imb, y_pred_proba_imb)
roc_auc = roc_auc_score(y_test_imb, y_pred_proba_imb)

plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
plt.plot(fpr, tpr, label=f"Random Forest (AUC = {roc_auc:.3f})")
plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], "k--", label="Random")
plt.xlabel("False Positive Rate")
plt.ylabel("True Positive Rate")

plt.legend()
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

sections.title: Example 4: Clustering Metrics
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 4: Clustering Metrics")
print("-" * 50)

# Generate clustering data
X_cluster, y_true = make_blobs(
    n_samples=300, centers=4, cluster_std=0.60, random_state=42
)

# Apply K-Means with different k values
k_values = range(2, 11)
metrics_cluster = {
    "Silhouette Score": [],
    "Davies-Bouldin Index": [],
    "Calinski-Harabasz Index": [],
    "Inertia": [],
}

for k in k_values:
    kmeans = KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10)
    labels = kmeans.fit_predict(X_cluster)

    # Calculate metrics
    silhouette = silhouette_score(X_cluster, labels)
    davies_bouldin = davies_bouldin_score(X_cluster, labels)
    calinski_harabasz = calinski_harabasz_score(X_cluster, labels)
    inertia = kmeans.inertia_

    metrics_cluster["Silhouette Score"].append(silhouette)
    metrics_cluster["Davies-Bouldin Index"].append(davies_bouldin)
    metrics_cluster["Calinski-Harabasz Index"].append(calinski_harabasz)
    metrics_cluster["Inertia"].append(inertia)

# Plot clustering metrics
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(15, 10))

for i, (metric_name, values) in enumerate(metrics_cluster.items()):
    row = i // 2
    col = i % 2

    axes[row, col].plot(k_values, values, "bo-")
    axes[row, col].set_xlabel("Number of Clusters (k)")
    axes[row, col].set_ylabel(metric_name)
    axes[row, col].set_title(f"{metric_name} vs k")
    axes[row, col].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

    # Mark optimal k
    if metric_name in ["Silhouette Score", "Calinski-Harabasz Index"]:
        optimal_k = k_values[np.argmax(values)]
        axes[row, col].axvline(
            x=optimal_k, color="red", linestyle="--", label=f"Optimal k = {optimal_k}"
        )
    else:
        optimal_k = k_values[np.argmin(values)]
        axes[row, col].axvline(
            x=optimal_k, color="red", linestyle="--", label=f"Optimal k = {optimal_k}"
        )
    axes[row, col].legend()

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

sections.title: Example 5: Cross-Validation with Multiple Metrics
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 5: Cross-Validation with Multiple Metrics")
print("-" * 50)

# Use the regression data from Example 1
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_validate

# Define scoring metrics for regression
scoring_reg = {
    "mae": "neg_mean_absolute_error",
    "mse": "neg_mean_squared_error",
    "rmse": "neg_root_mean_squared_error",
    "r2": "r2",
}

# Perform cross-validation
cv_results = cross_validate(
    RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, random_state=42),
    X_reg,
    y_reg,
    cv=5,
    scoring=scoring_reg,
    return_train_score=True,
)

# Display results
print("Cross-Validation Results (Random Forest):")
print(
    f"MAE: {-cv_results['test_mae'].mean():.4f} (+/- {cv_results['test_mae'].std() * 2:.4f})"
)
print(
    f"MSE: {-cv_results['test_mse'].mean():.4f} (+/- {cv_results['test_mse'].std() * 2:.4f})"
)
print(
    f"RMSE: {-cv_results['test_rmse'].mean():.4f} (+/- {cv_results['test_rmse'].std() * 2:.4f})"
)
print(
    f"R²: {cv_results['test_r2'].mean():.4f} (+/- {cv_results['test_r2'].std() * 2:.4f})"
)

# Visualize cross-validation results
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(15, 10))

metrics = ["mae", "mse", "rmse", "r2"]
metric_names = ["MAE", "MSE", "RMSE", "R²"]

for i, (metric, name) in enumerate(zip(metrics, metric_names)):
    row = i // 2
    col = i % 2

    test_scores = (
        -cv_results[f"test_{metric}"]
        if metric != "r2"
        else cv_results[f"test_{metric}"]
    )
    train_scores = (
        -cv_results[f"train_{metric}"]
        if metric != "r2"
        else cv_results[f"train_{metric}"]
    )

    axes[row, col].plot(range(1, 6), test_scores, "bo-", label="Test Score")
    axes[row, col].plot(range(1, 6), train_scores, "ro-", label="Train Score")
    axes[row, col].set_xlabel("Fold")
    axes[row, col].set_ylabel(name)
    axes[row, col].set_title(f"{name} Across Folds")
    axes[row, col].legend()
    axes[row, col].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

sections.title: Example 6: Model Comparison Framework
sections.body:
```python
print("\nExample 6: Model Comparison Framework")
print("-" * 50)

# Compare multiple models on the same dataset
models_comparison = {
    "Linear Regression": LinearRegression(),
    "Random Forest": RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, random_state=42),
}

# Store results for comparison
comparison_results = {}

for name, model in models_comparison.items():
    # Perform cross-validation
    cv_scores = cross_val_score(model, X_reg, y_reg, cv=5, scoring="r2")

    # Fit on full training data for final evaluation
    model.fit(X_train_reg, y_train_reg)
    y_pred = model.predict(X_test_reg)

    # Calculate metrics
    mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test_reg, y_pred)
    rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test_reg, y_pred))
    r2 = r2_score(y_test_reg, y_pred)

    comparison_results[name] = {
        "CV R² Mean": cv_scores.mean(),
        "CV R² Std": cv_scores.std(),
        "Test MAE": mae,
        "Test RMSE": rmse,
        "Test R²": r2,
    }

# Create comparison table
comparison_df = pd.DataFrame(comparison_results).T
print("Model Comparison Results:")
print(comparison_df.round(4))

# Visualize comparison
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 5))

metrics_compare = ["Test MAE", "Test RMSE", "Test R²"]
colors = ["skyblue", "lightcoral", "lightgreen"]

for i, metric in enumerate(metrics_compare):
    values = [comparison_results[model][metric] for model in comparison_results.keys()]
    bars = axes[i].bar(comparison_results.keys(), values, color=colors[i])
    axes[i].set_title(f"{metric} Comparison")
    axes[i].set_ylabel(metric)

    # Add value labels on bars
    for bar, value in zip(bars, values):
        axes[i].text(
            bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
            bar.get_height() + 0.01,
            f"{value:.4f}",
            ha="center",
            va="bottom",
        )

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

print("\nExample 7: Business Impact Metrics")

# Simulate business scenario: Customer churn prediction
np.random.seed(42)
n_customers = 1000

# Generate customer data
customer_data = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "tenure_months": np.random.exponential(24, n_customers),
        "monthly_charges": np.random.normal(65, 20, n_customers),
        "total_charges": np.random.normal(2000, 800, n_customers),
        "contract_type": np.random.choice([0, 1, 2], n_customers, p=[0.5, 0.3, 0.2]),
        "payment_method": np.random.choice([0, 1, 2, 3], n_customers),
    }
)

# Create target with business logic
customer_data["churn"] = (
    (customer_data["tenure_months"] < 12)
    | (customer_data["monthly_charges"] > 80)
    | (customer_data["contract_type"] == 0)
).astype(int)

# Business costs
cost_per_false_positive = 50  # Cost of unnecessary retention campaign
cost_per_false_negative = 200  # Cost of losing a customer
revenue_per_customer = 1000  # Monthly revenue per customer

# Train model
X_business = customer_data.drop("churn", axis=1)
y_business = customer_data["churn"]

X_train_biz, X_test_biz, y_train_biz, y_test_biz = train_test_split(
    X_business, y_business, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_business
)

# Scale features
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_biz_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_biz)
X_test_biz_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test_biz)

# Train model
rf_business = RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)
rf_business.fit(X_train_biz_scaled, y_train_biz)

# Make predictions
y_pred_biz = rf_business.predict(X_test_biz_scaled)
y_pred_proba_biz = rf_business.predict_proba(X_test_biz_scaled)[:, 1]

# Calculate confusion matrix
cm_biz = confusion_matrix(y_test_biz, y_pred_biz)
tn, fp, fn, tp = cm_biz.ravel()

# Calculate business metrics
total_cost = fp * cost_per_false_positive + fn * cost_per_false_negative
total_revenue = tp * revenue_per_customer
net_profit = total_revenue - total_cost
roi = (net_profit / total_cost) * 100 if total_cost > 0 else float("inf")

print("Business Impact Analysis:")
print(f"True Positives (Correctly identified churners): {tp}")
print(f"False Positives (Unnecessary retention campaigns): {fp}")
print(f"False Negatives (Missed churners): {fn}")
print(f"True Negatives (Correctly identified stayers): {tn}")
print(f"\nCost Analysis:")
print(f"Total Cost: ${total_cost:,.2f}")
print(f"Total Revenue: ${total_revenue:,.2f}")
print(f"Net Profit: ${net_profit:,.2f}")
print(f"ROI: {roi:.2f}%")

# Visualize business impact
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(15, 6))

# Confusion matrix
sns.heatmap(cm_biz, annot=True, fmt="d", cmap="Blues", ax=axes[0])
axes[0].set_title("Confusion Matrix - Churn Prediction")
axes[0].set_xlabel("Predicted")
axes[0].set_ylabel("Actual")

# Business metrics
business_metrics = ["Total Cost", "Total Revenue", "Net Profit"]
business_values = [total_cost, total_revenue, net_profit]
colors_biz = ["red", "green", "blue"]

bars = axes[1].bar(business_metrics, business_values, color=colors_biz)
axes[1].set_title("Business Impact Metrics")
axes[1].set_ylabel("Amount ($)")

# Add value labels
for bar, value in zip(bars, business_values):
    axes[1].text(
        bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2,
        bar.get_height() + 1000,
        f"${value:,.0f}",
        ha="center",
        va="bottom",
    )

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
